pre-commit.description: Renovate's pre-commit manager is opt-in. Without this the hook revisions in .pre-commit-config.yaml are the one dependency file nobody is watching -- and those hooks are the linters gating every commit.

packageRules.description: Group grpc packages together with widen strategy
Minor, patch and digest updates are not merged automatically: every update needs review

A Renovate major can raise engines.node past the node-version that .github/workflows/renovate.yml sets up, leaving every hourly run on a Node that Renovate does not support. This note reaches the reviewer of the bump.
prBodyNotes: :warning: Before merging, check this version's `engines.node` (`npm view renovate@<version> engines`) against `node-version` in `.github/workflows/renovate.yml`. If it no longer accepts that Node major, raise `node-version` in the same pull request, and in shakenfist/development's `templates/renovate/renovate.yml`, which every repository copies verbatim.

packageRules.description: shellcheck-py tags a fourth packaging component -- v0.11.0.1 is shellcheck 0.11.0, packaging revision 1 -- which is not semver, so without this the github-tags lookup behind the pre-commit hook fails with "Can't find version matching" on the dependency dashboard and no update is ever proposed. The fourth group is named build rather than revision: Renovate's regex versioning only compares revision when a build group matched too, so naming it revision would make v0.11.0.2 compare equal to v0.11.0.1 and hide packaging-only releases. The anchor to exactly four numeric components ignores re-tags such as v0.11.0.1-1. Harmless in a repository that does not use the hook. See templates/renovate/README.md in shakenfist/development.
